# Popover

Rich content in a floating panel, opened by click.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Content first</span> Only menus and dialogs float in Content first. A long aside opens in place with collapsible instead. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./collapsible">Collapsible</a>, <a href="./dialog">Dialog</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Extra detail or a small control next to what it explains, on any device.
- **Not when:** A one-line hint (tooltip), or a task that should block the page (dialog).

Instead:

- [Tooltip](./tooltip.md): A one-line hint on hover.
- [Dialog](./dialog.md): A blocking task.

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Escape closes it and returns focus. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The trigger says it opens a panel and whether it is open. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add popover
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
